value.rationale: The theorem determines a motivated infinite family of exact two-parameter cyclic pattern-avoidance numbers and its primitive necklace spectrum, rather than an arbitrary finite parameter or one small enumerative increment. The infinite forbidden basis collapses precisely on periodic points, and parity of the XOR code forces an exact twofold lift. The generating series and asymptotic leading constant make this periodic symbolic subsystem quantitatively explicit; the underlying source paper provided only the growth rate for all linear good words. This is a natural complete subclass with use for cyclic word design and subshift periodic-orbit counting.
